text: Ko Kanko seniiɗo On woni weertuɗo leydi ndin, O tagi pelle tabituɗe e mayri fii wata ndi yergu e yimɓe ɓen. O waɗi e noone kala e dimɗe ɗen, noone ɗiɗi gorel e deyel wano kulle ɗen. Himo suddira jemma on ñalorma on, o niɓɓita ɓaawo nde o jalbunoo. Wonii e ko jantaa koo, dalilaaji e ɓanngannduyeeji wonannde yimɓe miijitotooɓe taskoo ɓen e golle Alla ɗen, ko kamɓe nafitorta ɗin dalilaaji e ɓanngannduyeeji.
